text: Venue A in Pune accommodates 30 attendees in its workshop room.
Venue A cancellation: cancellations made 14 days before the workshop receive a full refund.
Venue A provides on-site vegetarian and non-vegetarian catering for workshop bookings.
Standard business travel reimbursement requires original receipts.
International travel requires manager approval before booking.
Bookings made after travel require a documented exception approved by finance.
